must_fix.title: Dialog focus trap leaks when the last focusable candidate is hidden (e.g. an unselected TabPanel)
must_fix.evidence: src/Dialog.tsx:12-21 getTabbables matches [tabindex] with no hidden/visibility filter; an unselected TabPanel (tabIndex=0, hidden) becomes 'last'. Probe: Dialog containing <button>first</button> + <Tabs defaultValue="a"> with 2 tabs/panels, with <button>outside</button> after the Dialog; repeated user.tab() printed 'tab 1 pa', 'tab 2 outsideTfirstABpapb' (document.body), 'tab 3 outside', so focus escaped the modal. No Dialog test covers hidden or conditional content.

must_fix.title: Dialog initial focus can land on a hidden element instead of the first visible one
must_fix.evidence:
src/Dialog.tsx:50-52 focuses getTabbables(dialog)[0] without a visibility check. Probe:
printed 'ACTIVE1 ' (in a browser focus() on a hidden element does nothing, so focus stays outside the dialog). A Dialog starting with printed 'init pa tabpanel', meaning focus went to the panel that ends up hidden rather than the selected tab, because the Tabs set tabIndex=0 on a tab only in a later re-render. This contradicts the issue ('moves focus inside') and the README ('first tabbable element').

nits: Uncontrolled Tabs without defaultValue render no selection on first paint and in SSR: all panels hidden, all tabs tabindex=-1, aria-selected=false (seen via renderToString).

'No results'

has no role=status/aria-live, so screen readers don't announce it.
The README Tabs keyboard table doesn't say disabled tabs are skipped by arrows and Home/End; only the props table does.
A clicked disabled tab still receives focus (aria-disabled only), and arrow keys do nothing from it because TabList.onKeyDown returns when index === -1.

report:
I've run the checks and probed the edge cases; here is the review. `pnpm test` passes (61 tests) and `pnpm typecheck` is clean. Tabs and Combobox behave as the issue asks. Dialog has two confirmed problems with focus handling, both caused by its list of focusable elements: it includes elements that are hidden. Probes ran from a temporary `tests/zz-probe.test.tsx`, which I deleted. `git status` is unchanged. ### Must fix **1. Dialog's focus trap lets focus leave when the last focusable element is hidden** (`src/Dialog.tsx:12-21`, `getTabbables`) The selector matches any `[tabindex]` and never checks whether the element is hidden. An unselected `TabPanel` has `tabIndex={0}` and `hidden`, so it counts as the dialog's "last" element. Pressing Tab from the real last element doesn't wrap, and focus leaves the dialog. Probe: a Dialog containing `` and then `` with tabs/panels a and b, with `` after the Dialog. Pressing Tab repeatedly gave: ``` start first tab 0 A tab 1 pa tab 2 outsideTfirstABpapb <- document.body tab 3 outside <- focus escaped the modal ``` The issue requires the dialog to trap focus. None of the Dialog tests put a hidden or conditionally shown element inside the dialog. **2. Dialog's initial focus can land on a hidden element instead of the first visible one** (`src/Dialog.tsx:50-52`) The same unfiltered list is used for focus on open: - `
` printed `ACTIVE1 `. jsdom focused the hidden button. In a real browser, `focus()` on a hidden element does nothing, so focus stays on the trigger outside the dialog. - A Dialog whose content starts with `` printed `init pa tabpanel`. Focus went to panel "a", which is hidden once the Tabs settle, not to the selected tab "B". This happens because Dialog's layout effect runs before the Tabs re-render that sets `tabIndex=0` on a tab. At that moment every tab has `tabIndex=-1` and the panels are the only tabbable elements. The issue requires focus to move inside the dialog on open. The README also promises "focus moves to the first tabbable element", which isn't true here. ### Nits - When Tabs has no `defaultValue` or `value`, the first render has no selected tab: every panel is `hidden` and every tab has `tabindex="-1"` and `aria-selected="false"`. A probe with `renderToString` showed this. The selection only fills in after a layout effect, so server-rendered output has no visible panel and no tab you can reach with Tab. - The "No results" `

` has no `role="status"` or `aria-live`, so screen readers don't announce it. - The README's Tabs keyboard table doesn't say that disabled tabs are skipped by the arrow keys and Home/End. Only the props table mentions it. - A disabled tab stays focusable when clicked (it uses `aria-disabled`, not `disabled`), and arrow keys do nothing while it has focus.
